apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: David's ball-into-wall isometric: four 30 s holds, leg straight, with 2 min rests. Ankle circles fill the first two rests. The routine strip now shows time left and total.

Leaving the app: the cue track is kept running (restarted if iOS stops it on the way out), and a stray pause iOS sends while you're leaving is ignored. Diagnostics now log what iOS does, in case it still happens.
Leaving the app no longer pauses your session. After the iOS update, iOS reports a fake 'interruption' when it backgrounds the app; real ones (a call, Siri, an alarm) still pause.
